The comparison now turns on (1) whether restriction of favouring content is a limitation (row 3b), (2) what individuates favourings: whether two distinct non-conflicting favourings of one simple bearer are two or one (price of denying 3e6ae3e7), (3) the criterion as a direct assumption on value-responsiveness, at parity with the axiarchic primitive, (4) the final cause as object as a reading of (e), (5) goodness variation within one end-realization class, (6) the reception fork shared with the wisdom route once the criterion is granted, (7) a will-recognition bridge with the governing relation explicit.

current_assessment.scope: Joint coherence of (a)-(e) for an impersonal foundation; cross-family argument from finality to limitation and cognition
current_assessment.assessment: Relative to the #2153 E∘L bundle d3051570, horn A swaps E for the purity of good-generality (e2357adc) and one-favouring realization (3e6ae3e7); under them a simple, necessary, noncognitive foundation cannot have a favouring determined to one content. This relocates the q.19 a.4 transfer principle into those two premises; it adds no warrant by itself. The foundation can still be composite; simple with two distinct non-conflicting favourings in one respect; a bearer of a pure determination-to-one that excludes another pure perfection; one whose good-generality is impure or inadmissible; good-general and noncognitive by denying the cognition criterion, which is a direct assumption on value-responsiveness at parity with that denial; or the final cause as object with no favouring of its own (noncognitive in its Plotinian form; Aristotle's first mover thinks). Selection among tied creations is a shared price; contingency of creation as such separates permissive from categorical accounts on both sides. The finality route is a conditional support option for 29818edd that avoids 180f5ad2, fe67d766 and E but shares the whole #2153 background with the E∘L route. No unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Is restriction of favouring content a limitation (RequiresLack test against PureRequiresNoPureLack, both sides)? What individuates favourings (two distinct non-conflicting favourings of one bearer, or their union)? State value-responsiveness without presence as content positively; test the final cause as object against coordinated order; goodness variation within a D-class; a will-recognition bridge with BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_3 explicit; register controls as models.
